caption_L1: Here a line plot is called Total number of prepaid mobile subscribers in Canada from 2010 to 2019 (in millions). The y-axis shows Number of subscribers in millions with linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 5 while the x-axis measures Year as linear scale from 2010 to 2018.
caption_L2L3: Since 2010 there has been a steady decline of prepaid mobile subscribers in most years with it falling from about 4.6 million in 2010 to just 2.5 million in 2019.  2016 - 2017 showed slight signs of reversal with a rise of about .25 million but this was short lived and the downward trend then resumed.
